about.title: About me
about.p1: I recently finished my degree in Information Technology and I am looking for my first role in cybersecurity or software development.
about.p2: I enjoy understanding how systems work and how they fail: from network traffic and web vulnerabilities to the code behind them. I learn by doing, in labs, CTFs and personal projects.
about.p3: I am curious, methodical and I like to document what I learn.
